outcome: composite maternal adverse outcome without transfusion
cohort: Nulliparous individuals with class III obesity (BMI >= 40 kg/m^2) prepregnancy, with singleton, nonanomalous pregnancies, delivering at 37 to 41 weeks of gestation, and without hypertensive disorders or diabetes.
finding: In nulliparous individuals with class III obesity, the risk of composite neonatal adverse outcome (CNAO) and composite maternal adverse outcome (CMAO) without transfusion were significantly lower in individuals who labored, compared to those who had a planned cesarean delivery.
